suite: PATH customer portal and Louisiana project delivery

scenarios.precondition: Fresh demo state and signed in as Alex Martin
scenarios.action: Open Schedule from primary navigation and select a workstream row
expected_ui: Schedule is a primary nav item
Baseline and forecast dates are visible
Internal notes and what-if controls are absent
A workstream row is keyboard/click actionable
scenarios.pass_artifact: Screenshot of customer-safe schedule and opened detail

scenarios.action: Review command center summary and open a customer action
expected_ui: Project stage, health, baseline, forecast, variance
expected_data: Overview is derived from project/workstream records
scenarios.expected_persistence: Overview values are unchanged after reload without mutations

scenarios.precondition: Fresh state; request center menu visible
navigation: Submit / track a permit or authorization
scenarios.action: Choose a verified permit, complete context, and submit
expected_ui: Trigger, prerequisites, duration, statutory minimum, agency contact, filing mode, official link
Request is listed in tracking list
expected_notification: State Project Office notification with confirmation number

scenarios.precondition: Permit wizard open for an EXTERNAL_PORTAL permit
scenarios.action: Enter external reference, official record URL, and manually verified status; submit
expected_ui: No claim that PATH submitted the statutory filing
External filing is visible in project permit portfolio

scenarios.action: Submit outcome, area, desired date, known agency, and blocking flag
expected_notification: High or critical state office notification

scenarios.action: Describe critical-path risk and submit escalation

scenarios.precondition: Structured service form open with title or description entered
expected_notification: Draft is recorded without an urgent triage notification requirement

scenarios.precondition: Fresh state and a small local file available
scenarios.action: Upload a revision and download the new exact version
expected_ui: Filename, size, SHA-256, version tag, uploader, status under review, DOTD/CPRA review assignments
Download control targets the selected version
expected_data: DocumentVersionRecord has immutable id, hash, file metadata, storage path, and agencyReviews
scenarios.expected_persistence: New version and download target survive reload

scenarios.action: Edit phone, location, preferred contact method, and availability; save; reload
expected_ui: Directory shows realistic work email and role
Organization and project role are read-only
scenarios.expected_persistence: Updated contact fields remain after reload

expected_ui: State, agency, parish, and customer-visible participants are listed
Concierge contact is Sarah Johnson at la.gov

scenarios.precondition: Fresh state and signed in as Jordan Lee
scenarios.action: Review buckets and open an item
expected_ui: Exactly one primary bucket per item
Personal assignment is distinct from LDEQ queue eligibility
expected_data: No item ID appears in more than one bucket
scenarios.expected_persistence: Queue classification remains stable after reload

scenarios.action: Review participants, profiles, roles, and capabilities
expected_data: Joe has admin workspace and full permission set

scenarios.precondition: A document version with DOTD review assignment exists
scenarios.action: Approve or request revision on the selected version
expected_ui: Decision applies to selected immutable version
Comments are visible to authorized participants
expected_data: Only the selected agency review changes
Version status changes when review rules are satisfied

scenarios.precondition: At least one request and one uploaded document version exist
scenarios.action: Run reset script, start a fresh app process, and revisit request/documents views
expected_data: Repository reset returns deterministic fixture counts
scenarios.expected_persistence: Fresh process has baseline fixture state
